meta.title: Lantai core memory
meta.description: Manage automatic loading and independent automatic extraction to Lantai in DSH General settings; both are off by default. In configured folders, loading uses an encrypted connection to load rules (policy), personal information (identity), and explicitly configured task progress (task); memory is sent to the conversation model and retained in chat history, and turning loading off keeps existing history. Extraction processes only future user text in main conversations in configured folders, does not backfill history, and sends that text to Lantai for processing. Turning extraction off stops new task submissions, but tasks already accepted by Lantai may still finish and write memories.

client.title: Load Lantai memory automatically
client.description: Applies to conversations in configured folders. Memory is sent to the model and may be visible to anyone who can view the conversation. Turning it off keeps existing history.
client.extractionTitle: Automatically extract and save to Lantai
client.extractionDescription: Processes only user text in main conversations in configured folders from this point forward; it does not backfill history. User text is sent to Lantai for processing. Turning this off stops new task submissions, but tasks already accepted by Lantai may still finish and write memories. Existing memories are not deleted.
client.extractionScope: Only future user text in main conversations is processed; no history backfill.

client.scopeChanged: The memory scope changed. Automatic loading is off.
client.extractionScopeChanged: The write scope changed. Automatic extraction is off.
